h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Alappuzha

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Alappuzha

items.pText: Alappuzha's resorts, homestays and houseboat operators host many families, and a play lawn by the water gives children something to do between boat rides. FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer supplying Alappuzha's resorts, schools and housing projects from our factory in Vasai, about 1,160 km away. We send the equipment by road to Kerala and install it with our team or a dealer.

Few places are wetter than Alappuzha. It gets rain from both the southwest and the northeast monsoons, the land is low and close to the backwaters, and the air near the coast carries salt. Bare iron does not last in these conditions. Galvanised steel posts, roto-moulded plastic parts and composite laminates are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant, so they suit a lakeside lawn far better. Where the ground stays soft or waterlogged, we suggest raising the play area and grouting the posts into a concrete base.

items.q: Will playground equipment rust near the backwaters?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are corrosion-resistant, which is why we use them. Near salt air, rinse the equipment with fresh water now and then and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

items.q: Can you install on soft or waterlogged ground?
items.a: We suggest raising the play area above the surrounding ground and grouting the posts into a concrete base. A slight slope and rubber flooring help water drain away after heavy rain.

items.q: Do you have designs that suit a resort setting?
items.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals ranges, including Kagzi and Nature Sparsh, are designed by our own team and look different from standard park equipment. We also offer design customisation on request.
